factories.name: newSearchTasksStep
factories.description: Search one Workspace's tasks by List, Folder, Space, status, assignee, tag, and update time, returning one page of up to 100 tasks and the next page number.

inputSchema.description: SearchTasksInput filters one Workspace's tasks. Every non-empty filter narrows the search, and the values of one list filter are alternatives.

areSubtasksIncluded.description: AreSubtasksIncluded also returns subtasks; ClickUp excludes them by default.

assigneeIds.description: AssigneeIDs keeps tasks assigned to any of these user IDs.

folderIds.description: FolderIDs keeps tasks of Lists in these Folders.

isClosedIncluded.description: IsClosedIncluded also returns tasks in a closed status; ClickUp excludes them by default.

listIds.description: ListIDs keeps tasks of these Lists.

orderBy.description: OrderBy is created, updated, due_date, or id; empty uses ClickUp's default order by creation.

page.description: Page is the zero-based page to read; continue with SearchTasksOutput.NextPage.

spaceIds.description: SpaceIDs keeps tasks of these Spaces.

statuses.description: Statuses keeps tasks in these status names, such as in progress.

tags.description: Tags keeps tasks with any of these tag names.

updatedAfter.description: UpdatedAfter keeps tasks updated after this time, for polling changes since a checkpoint.

workspaceId.description: WorkspaceID is the Workspace (ClickUp API team) ID, the first number in a ClickUp web address.

factories.name: newGetTaskStep
factories.description: Read one task by ID or custom task ID with its status, priority, dates, assignees, tags, List, Markdown description, and custom field values.

isCustomTaskId.description: IsCustomTaskID reads TaskID as the Workspace's custom task ID; it requires WorkspaceID.

taskId.description: TaskID is ClickUp's task ID, the code after /t/ in the task's web address, or a custom task ID such as DEV-123 when IsCustomTaskID is set.

workspaceId.description: WorkspaceID is the Workspace of a custom task ID; leave it empty for an ordinary task ID.

factories.name: newCreateTaskStep
factories.description: Create one task in a List with a name, Markdown description, status, priority, due time, assignees, tags, parent task, and custom field values. ClickUp has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability, records a Dex heartbeat checkpoint before sending, and reconciles an unconfirmed attempt by reading the List back instead of resending.

CustomFieldInput.description: CustomFieldInput sets one custom field on a new task.

id.description: ID is the custom field's ID, from getTask or ClickUp's Get Accessible Custom Fields.

value.description: Value is the JSON value ClickUp expects for the field's type, such as "text", 5, or an option ID.

inputSchema.description: CreateTaskInput is one task to create in a List.

assigneeIds.description: AssigneeIDs are the users to assign, such as a findMemberByEmail result's ID.

customFields.description: CustomFields set custom field values; ClickUp ignores fields that do not apply to the task.

dueAt.description: DueAt is the due date and time; nil sets none.

isCreatorNotified.description: IsCreatorNotified also notifies the token's user; assignees and watchers are always notified.

listId.description: ListID is the List to create the task in, the number after /li/ in the List's web address.

markdownDescription.description: MarkdownDescription is the description in Markdown, at most MaxDescriptionBytes; empty sets none.

name.description: Name is the task name. A retried attempt finds its earlier task by this name, so a name that carries the application's own request key, such as [REQ-1042], makes reconciliation unambiguous.

parentTaskId.description: ParentTaskID creates a subtask of this task, which must be in the same List; empty creates a task.

priority.description: Priority is 1 urgent through 4 low; zero sets no priority.

status.description: Status is a status name of the List's workflow, such as in progress; empty uses the List's first status.

tags.description: Tags are tag names of the List's Space to add.

factories.name: newUpdateTaskStep
factories.description: Change one task's name, Markdown description, status, priority, or due time, and add or remove assignees; every change is an absolute value or a set membership, so a repeated update leaves the same task.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTaskInput changes one task. Only set fields change; every change is an absolute value or a set membership, so a repeated update leaves the same task.

addAssigneeIds.description: AddAssigneeIDs assigns these users; an existing assignee stays assigned.

dueAt.description: DueAt sets the due date and time; nil keeps it.

markdownDescription.description: MarkdownDescription replaces the description with Markdown when set; a pointer to "" clears it.

name.description: Name renames the task when set.

priority.description: Priority sets 1 urgent through 4 low; zero keeps the current priority.

removeAssigneeIds.description: RemoveAssigneeIDs unassigns these users; a user who is not assigned is ignored.

status.description: Status moves the task to a status name of its List's workflow, such as in progress; empty keeps it.

factories.name: newUpdateTaskTagsStep
factories.description: Add tags to and remove tags from one task, then read the task's tags back; adding a present tag or removing an absent one changes nothing, so a repeated update is safe.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTaskTagsInput adds tags to and removes tags from one task.

addTags.description: AddTags are tag names to add; a tag the task already has stays.

removeTags.description: RemoveTags are tag names to remove from the task; the tag stays in the Space.

factories.name: newAddCommentStep
factories.description: Add one plain-text comment, authored by the token's user, to a task. ClickUp has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability, records a Dex heartbeat checkpoint before sending, and reconciles an unconfirmed attempt by reading the task's comments back instead of resending.

inputSchema.description: AddCommentInput is one plain-text comment to add to a task.

isCreatorNotified.description: IsCreatorNotified also notifies the token's user; assignees and watchers are always notified.

text.description: Text is the comment's plain text, at most MaxCommentBytes; ClickUp shows it as written.

factories.name: newFindMemberByEmailStep
factories.description: Find the member of one Workspace whose email address equals the given address, returning the numeric user ID that task assignees use.

inputSchema.description: FindMemberByEmailInput names one Workspace and one email address.

email.description: Email is one bare email address, compared without regard to case.

workspaceId.description: WorkspaceID is the Workspace (ClickUp API team) ID, the first number in a ClickUp web address.
